objects.note: Linked under --remove-eh too: see the note on the dl_iterate_phdr wrap.

wrap.note: Synthetic program headers for libunwind: musl's dl_iterate_phdr walks an empty dso list in a statically linked guest with no loader, so the runtime would never find .eh_frame_hdr and every throw would fail fast. Applied under --remove-eh as well, even though there is then no unwind index to point at. Dropping it does not leave musl's harmless stub: the zkVM targets link noos, whose dl_iterate_phdr is a trap, and the runtime asks for module headers from RhRegisterOSModule during start-up - so the guest died with 253 before reaching Main, rather than failing fast on a throw the way the policy says. The module answers the no-index case by reporting the load segment alone (see module.c).
